fixed_intervention: Raw metadata truthfully stays fixed5. A recorded-evaluation adapter projects only the controller's requested-mode FPS label to its logical 2/5 state, clears non-executed pending sensing proposals and logs suppression. It preserves incident/recovery rules, real observations and actual applied IDs. It manufactures no ACK and is not the unmodified deployment transport protocol.

paired_acceptance.delay_scope: Provisional engineering comparison against fixed5 for matched recovery/test-alert events, not a calibrated safety requirement or annotated fall latency

limits: three repeated pairs per each of three known development recordings
order alternates within pairs; 9 pairs cannot balance first position perfectly
repetitions assess runtime variation, not independent incidents
no dense independent ground truth or clinical/fall accuracy claim
sitting UNRESOLVED is a known limitation of person-only profile, not correct benign classification
fixed5 uses explicit non-actuating logical-mode evaluation adapter
no scene/model/threshold tuning after results; retain all attempts
all cloud work remains on existing Graviton + native COOL; no new AWS resources

assessment.scope: Known-development-video rate-policy comparison; not fall accuracy or 30 FPS savings
